description:
Grant an agent a covenant: an explicit lease of authority. scopes support
    wildcards ('payments.*', '*'); budget_minor is the total spend ceiling in
    minor units; expires_at is ISO-8601. Returns the covenant_id.

agent_id.description: Id of the agent receiving (or, when listing, bound by) the covenant.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

budget_minor.description: Total spend ceiling in minor units (cents).
budget_minor.title: Budget Minor

principal.description: Id of the party granting authority.
principal.title: Principal

scopes.description: Allowed actions, wildcards supported, for example ["payments.*"].
scopes.title: Scopes

name: grant_covenant
title: Grant covenant
